account_email^[A-Za-z0-9.!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+@[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9-]{0,61}[A-Za-z0-9])?(?:\\.[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9-]{0,61}[A-Za-z0-9])?)+$mira.okafor@northwind-logistics.co.ukEnter a complete email address, including the domain (for example, name@company.com).
phone_e164^\\+[1-9]\\d{7,14}$+442079460958Use international format: a plus sign followed by 8–15 digits, with no spaces, hyphens, or parentheses.
postal_code_us^\\d{5}(?:-\\d{4})?$94107-2231Enter a 5-digit ZIP code or ZIP+4 (for example, 94107 or 94107-2231).
effective_date^\\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(0[1-9]|[12]\\d|3[01])$2024-02-29Use YYYY-MM-DD; the month must be 01–12 and the day 01–31.
currency_amount^(?:0|[1-9]\\d{0,8})(?:\\.\\d{2})?$12500.00Enter a non-negative amount up to 999,999,999.99 with two decimal places; omit commas.
slug^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$quarterly-compliance-reviewUse lowercase letters, numbers, and single hyphens only; do not start or end with a hyphen.
eu_vat_id^[A-Z]{2}[0-9A-Z]{8,12}$DE811234567Enter the country code followed by 8–12 letters or digits, without spaces.
